refutes.statement: Conjecture DL_RC (ledger K4.DL2.RC; k4/dlrc.c header): at f >= 1 every min-frozen P with def(P) > 0 has a min-frozen P' with def(P') < def(P) reached by a move of R_C = T1 (re-base) + T2 (rotation of free agents) + T3+ (the frozen-chain role swap: NA kept, exactly one x frozen -> free, exactly one z free -> frozen needing its new good in P, W the changed agents frozen in both, at most one helper free in both giving up a good of its base, the bases of W + z in P' exactly those of W + x in P) + T4 (frozen agents permute their goods). Here f = 1, def(P) = 1 at P = ({11}, {12}, {3,7}, {4,8}, {5,9}) and none of the 84 better min-frozen states is an R_C move: the 6 nearest (distance 3) are role swaps whose one helper GROWS its base by a junk good, the 78 others (distance 4) role swaps with two helpers

Conjecture DL_RT4 (ledger K4.DL2.RT4; k4/dlrt4.c header): the same with T3 (W empty) in place of T3+. At f = 1 R_C = RT4 (T3+ with W nonempty and T4 need a second frozen agent), so P refutes DL_RT4 too, at f = 1 and not by a chain state

repair.move: role swap with a growing helper (not R_C): agent 0 (frozen on 11, which agents 2 and 3 need) releases 11 for {0, 2} and becomes free; agent 3 takes {11} and freezes; helper 1 grows {12} -> {1, 12}; NA = {11} kept. T3+ requires the helper to give up a good. At distance 4, e.g. ({9}, {1,6}, {3,7}, {11}, {12}) with def -1: a role swap with two helpers (agents 1 and 4)

key_form.move: a T3 (= T3+ with W empty) move from another state of P's key (def* = 1): x = 0 -> {9}, z = 2 -> {11}, helper 4 {5,9} -> {12}; the key reached has def* = -1, so DL on the key graph holds
